item.title: ELDER: Obama’s race-hustling eulogy at a race hustler’s funeral | The North State Journal
item.description: Former President Barack Obama long ago surpassed the Rev. Jesse Jackson and the Rev. Al Sharpton as America’s most influential race hustler. The country got a reminder when Obama spoke at Jackson’s funeral even though Jackson’s son urged the speakers “not to bring their politics” to the service.
